title: Everything Claude Code — A battle-tested toolkit of agents crafted by Anthropic hackathon winner

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Created by Anthropic Hackathon winner. This repository isn't just a list of prompts. It's a battle tested configuration suite that turns clawed code from a chatbot into a senior engineer. It includes custom skills for test-driven development, automated hooks that lint and type check every file the AI writes. If you want to stop fighting with context windows and start shipping production code, this is the config you need to clone.
